scope: dev-only grounded answer: query -> read-only Retriever (hybrid, top_k 5) -> evidence context -> LlmProvider -> structured answer -> application-resolved citations; no eligibility decision, no MySQL lookup

retrieval.rule: uses retrieval.Retriever unchanged; mode and top_k equal the Retrieval Evaluation baseline (gold-v1) and change only with a new evaluation
retrieval.role_basis: 2026-10-03 user approval: application forms are not answer/eligibility evidence; missing role and UNKNOWN retained

context.evidence_id: request-local E1..En in retrieval rank order
fields: location (pages, or HWPX section when no page)
context.excluded: chunk_id, pblanc_id, source_sha256, parse_key, raw provenance, scores and other payload fields are never sent to the LLM

prompt.rule: one provider-neutral baseline prompt; no model-specific prompt variants

grounding_rules: answer only from the provided evidence; no general knowledge
never add or complete numbers, dates, amounts or eligibility conditions that are not in the evidence
state conflicts between evidence items explicitly
when the evidence does not answer the question, set insufficient_evidence=true and say it cannot be confirmed from the provided announcements
citation_rule: the LLM returns only evidence ids; the application validates them against the request context and resolves every citation field (chunk_id, pblanc_id, title, pages, source, provenance) from the retrieved SearchResult; unknown ids are dropped and reported, never turned into citations

status.ANSWERED: answer with at least one valid cited evidence
status.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the model reported missing evidence, or returned an answer with no valid evidence id; the answer text is replaced by insufficient_message and the model text is kept only as discarded_answer
status.insufficient_message: 제공된 공고문 근거만으로는 확인할 수 없습니다.
status.NO_CANDIDATES: the structured MySQL filter produced no candidate announcement; no retrieval and no LLM call

provider.rule: providers implement rag.llm.LlmProvider (generate(LlmRequest) -> LlmResponse); switching provider must not change orchestration, prompt, context or retrieval contract

bedrock.api: ConverseStream + forced emit_result tool input JSON schema + application validation
bedrock.authentication: boto3 credential chain only; AWS_PROFILE=bizaid-dev locally, empty on EC2 IAM role; no explicit keys/list APIs
bedrock.output_limit: request cap or local default 2048; max_tokens stop or count >= cap fails closed
bedrock.deadline: internal-api llm_call deadline_seconds; monotonic whole call/stream deadline, no prefix success
bedrock.provider_error: llm_provider_unavailable -> HTTP 503; raw SDK exception message is not reflected to clients
bedrock.basis: 2026-10-04 user-approved Bundle4; share prompt/retrieval/eligibility contracts, no V1 change

candidate_scope.source: candidates.ProgramCandidateService (MySQL support_programs, read-only) decides candidate pblanc_ids before retrieval
candidate_scope.rule: RagService passes the candidate set to Retriever.search(pblanc_ids=...) which enforces it as a Qdrant MatchAny payload filter; results outside the set fail with retrieval_scope_violation
candidate_scope.empty: an empty candidate set returns NO_CANDIDATES without query embedding, Qdrant search or LLM call

natural_filter.llm_role: proposes filter inputs only; SQL, lifecycle, candidate selection, dates and retrieval query stay with the application
natural_filter.domain: categories and targets are validated against distinct values of active support_programs; values outside the domain are not applied and are reported as unapplied
natural_filter.jurisdiction: not extracted from natural language: 16 jurisdiction_name values are regional governments whose names equal region words, so a region mention cannot be told apart from an agency; manual --jurisdiction stays available
natural_filter.currently_open: currently_open_requested=true sets not_closed_on to the application date (Asia/Seoul today or explicit as_of); undated programs stay as period_unknown (IMP-011)
natural_filter.failure: non-JSON or schema mismatch raises filter_extraction_* without falling back to an unfiltered candidate set
natural_filter.query: the original user query is used unchanged for retrieval and answer generation (no query rewrite)
natural_filter.cli: --natural-filter is mutually exclusive with manual filters; --as-of requires --natural-filter
natural_filter.grounding: hard filters apply only when grounded in the query: category/target values must be allowed domain values whose text appears in the query (whitespace-insensitive); currently_open_requested applies only when an open-phrase (지금·현재·신청 가능·모집 중·마감 안 등) appears; ungrounded proposals and free-text unapplied constraints not found in the query are kept only in discarded diagnostics

discovery.request_mode: SEARCH_LIST (from the same natural-filter extraction call); DOCUMENT_QA keeps the existing grounded answer path
discovery.rule: the output unit is the program: dense and sparse retrieval each return the best chunk per pblanc_id (Qdrant query_points_groups, group_size 1, up to group_limit_per_mode programs, candidate scope filter), and the program rankings are fused by the existing RRF (k=60); chunk-level top-N truncation is not used, so several chunks of one program cannot take several list slots; these settings are separate from the RAG retrieval baseline (hybrid, top_k 5)
discovery.metadata: support_programs values as stored: pblanc_id, name, category, target, jurisdiction_name, executing_org_name, application_start_date, application_end_date, application_period_raw, announcement_url, plus rrf_score, dense_rank, sparse_rank and evidence_chunk_id as ranking evidence
discovery.llm: no answer-generation LLM call; the list is deterministic

status.LISTED: at least one indexed candidate program
status.NO_CANDIDATES: empty structured candidate set; no Qdrant call
status.NO_INDEXED_PROGRAMS: candidates exist but none has indexed chunks

discovery.fill_rule: never add programs outside the candidate scope or without retrieved evidence to reach max_programs; fewer relevant programs are returned instead
discovery.calls: two Qdrant group queries per request (dense, sparse); no per-candidate queries and no extra LLM call

list_deduplication.policy: first existing RRF-ranked occurrence per pblanc_id or normalized business title + same jurisdiction/category/target
list_deduplication.normalization: NFKC; year/round and announcement-status suffix removed; region tags and business words preserved; short names use pblanc_id
list_deduplication.no_refill: never add out-of-scope or lower unqueried candidates to fill omitted slots

personalized_ranking.basis: 2026-10-03 one V2 finance query: top10 RRF 0.02626..0.03110, Gyeonggi rank6 0.02804 vs national rank3 0.02847. Add 0.001 only inside top10 and >=90% of best original score. No query/vector/RRF changes. Zero bonus preserves order.

question_routing.priority: explicit selected ID; list intent; named detail question; otherwise existing LLM
question_routing.selection: name match score, OPEN (both dates known and covering as_of), latest source_created_at; unresolved ties return SELECTION_REQUIRED, no retrieval or answer LLM; selected ID must be active

company_region_query.scope: SEARCH_LIST and generic DOCUMENT_QA use same company-region contract as personalized search
company_region_query.named_exception: explicit selected ID or recognized announcement name => region exclusion bypassed, outside-region warning; other lifecycle/contract validation retained
company_region_query.missing: no company/blank/legacy region => full regional scope, not guessed

context_table_presentation.policy: lossless flat triplet cell list at model context only; no row/span inference; mixed plain text kept; original chunks/IDs/vectors unchanged
context_table_presentation.scope: shared build_context for DOCUMENT_QA and eligibility
